items.title: Submit certificate of enrolment for winter semester 2026/27
items.quote: Please send us the certificate for the winter semester 2026/27 by 11 January 2027.
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar date by which the certificate must reach the insurer: 11 January 2027. Checking the weekday: counting forward from today (Tuesday, 2026-11-24) in 7-day steps lands on Tuesday 2027-01-12, so 2027-01-11 is a Monday, a normal business day in NW (not a weekend or public holiday). No statutory period-counting rule applies since this is a privately set deadline given as a fixed date, not a period running from service of the letter. The date as printed is therefore the due date.

items.title: Policy switches to standard rate if certificate not received in time
items.quote: If it does not reach us by then, we will switch your policy to the standard rate from February 2027.
items.computation: This is the stated consequence if the certificate is not received by 2027-01-11; the insurer specifies the rate change takes effect from February 2027, i.e. starting 2027-02-01. This is informational (a consequence), not a separate action the person must take.
